no_hallucination_rule: Every number, phone, email, weight, karat claim, and policy rule must appear on the linked official source page. If a cited URL returns 404 or redirects away from the cited document, it is repointed to the live official page; if a value is absent from the official pages read, it is deleted (set to null) rather than left unsourced.
